name: findcheap-agent
description: Search products from text or visual evidence, compare verified offers, find deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.13.1 keeps budgets and usage out of product identity searches, reopens exact official products through verified page JSON-LD when legacy Shopify JSON is unavailable, and returns explicit selected-product, price, timestamp, inventory, and deal evidence. Official-store results remain separate from trusted exact and similar matches. Affiliate relationships are disclosed but never affect eligibility or ranking. Price-history and buy-or-wait forecasting remain disabled. Authorized bounded Chrome search remains a user-approved fallback only after eligible API searches return no usable result. The agent never invents identity, discount eligibility, stacking, or delivered totals; it never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Clear shopping request: call matching tool now. No Memory, repo scan, plan narration, or manual MCP launch.
